about: stagewright wind-tunnel environment. Values are the stage contract recorded in stagewright's CLAUDE.md: Z-up, centimeters, 60 time codes per second, payload root /Environment, and the blueprint flow domain (X -144..144, Y -650..430, Z -4..248 cm) inside the environment's geometry. The component regions come from the geometry spec in stagewright's docs/plan.md: the plenum hall (about 2400 wide, Y -1600..1700, 1200 high), the tunnel from the collector at Y -1100 to the upstream end of the nozzle body at Y +1575 across the 650 nozzle exit width and the height of the flow domain, and the floor under the 1000 turntable centred on Y 93 between the domain floor and the floor top.
